en: Black‑and‑white image of an old-fashioned kiosk or newsstand filled with books, magazines, and racks of postcards. The stand has large glass windows, decorative metal brackets, hanging lamps, and a striped awning on the left. The surrounding area appears to be a wooden platform, possibly near a station or port. The visible printed items show small images and lettering but are not legible in detail.
